title: Rook Lift, Queen Swing
setup: Your queen owns the seventh rank, and your rook on d6 can swing across to the g-file in one move.
hint: Your queen already seals one whole rank. Bring a second piece up, and then look at the empty h-file.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on **e7** covers the entire seventh rank, so the king is confined to the eighth. {{Rg6+}} forces {{Kh8}}, and the rook now guards g7 and g8 as well. That frees the queen for {{Qh4#}} down the empty h-file.
